div.head: Had 1
div.ab: Seofonfealde gyfa syndan Haliges gastes; and VII stæpas syndan cyriclicra grada 7 haligra hada; 7 VII syðan Godes þeowas sceolon God herian dæghwamlice on cyrcan 7 for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.
(Quot sunt dona Spiritus sancti.) Septem sunt dona Sancti spiritus et septem gradus ecclesię et sanctorum ordinum; et septies in die laudes Deo dicende (canende) sunt ab omni ecclesia.

Seofonfealde gifa sind Haliges gastes; and seofon stapas sindon ciriclicra gráda 7 haligra háda; and sifon siðan Godes þeowas sculon . . . hergan dæghwamlice on circan 7 for eal Cristen folc þingian georne.

Seofonfealde gyfa syndan Haliges Gastes; and VII stæpas syndan cyriclicra grada and haligra hada; and VII syðan Godes þeowas sceolon God herian dæghwamlice on cyrcan and for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.

Siebenfältig sind die Gaben des Heiligen Geistes; und sieben Stufen der kirchlichen Grade und heiligen Ordines [giebt es], und siebenmal täglich sollen die Gottesdiener Gott preisen in der Kirche und für das ganze Christliche Volk eifrig fürbitten.

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and [there are] seven steps of the church's grades and holy orders; and seven times daily the servants of God shall praise God in church and pray earnestly for all Christian people.

Seven-fold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and there are seven steps of the ecclesiastical degrees and holy orders, and seven times a day should the servants of God praise God in church and intercede zealously for all Christian people.

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and seven are the steps of ecclesiastical ranks and holy orders; and seven times daily should God’s servants praise God in church and diligently advocate for all Christian people.
div.note: Liebermann prints D (f. 102, after Að without a break), O (p. 419, after Að without a break) and H (Textus Roffensis f. 7, after Wihtred, c. 1120); here hq (exemplar of H and the Quadripartitus) separates from the other MSS. K is H; D is also given here. H's ‘Seofonfealde’ was altered to ‘Seofan.’. Liebermann dates Hadbot c. 1030–c. 1050. Liebermann compares Að 2 and I Cn 4.3.
sceolon God herian: sculon hergan D

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit: Isaiah 11:2–3 lists the seven gifts of the Holy Spirit as wisdom (sapientia), understanding (intellectus), counsel (consilium), fortitude (fortitudo), knowledge (scientia), godliness (pietas), and fear of the Lord (timor Domini). seven are the steps of ecclesiastical ranks: The seven grades in the ecclesiastical hierarchy are doorkeeper (ostiarius), reader (lector), exorcist (exorcista), acolyte (acolitus), subdeacon (subdiaconus), deacon (diaconus), and priest (presbyter).
